_schema.purpose: Human rulings for names the halal screen returns CANNOT-VERIFY on. Consulted by day-trading.py::halal_check ONLY when its own computed verdict would be CANNOT-VERIFY: a ruling converts CV->PASS or CV->FAIL. It can NEVER override a hard industry FAIL or a ratio FAIL (a PASS ruling clears only the unverifiability -- the debt/cash ratio verdict still runs), and a FAIL ruling is never re-litigated.
_schema.key: ticker symbol, UPPERCASE. Keys starting with '_' are documentation, never tickers.

fields.verdict: PASS | FAIL convert the CV verdict. CANNOT-VERIFY records a name that was REVIEWED and deliberately left unresolved (the engine ignores it -- the name stays untradeable). Any other value is ignored.
fields.basis: free text: the evidence the ruling rests on (EDGAR segment note, business description, product mix, ...)
fields.haram_share_est: estimated haram revenue share in percent (number), or null if not quantified
fields.class: OPTIONAL. 'B-no-financials' marks a ruling made under the user's 2026-08-22 exception ('the only exception for my halal rules: the stocks that are not verifiable because we could not find its finances. then for these use zoya and etc.'): the external screener's FULL verdict (their AAOIFI thresholds included) is adopted whole because our 10/10/20 cannot run without financials. halal_check consults the overlay on its NO-FUNDAMENTALS-DATA branch ONLY for rulings so marked. Absent field = Class A: financials exist, the ruling clears/fails only the activity leg and ratios still gate.

_schema.workflow: Candidates + assembled evidence live in data/halal_review_queue.md, built by plan/build_review_queue.py. Rulings recorded here take effect on the next halal_check call.
